questionText: Volume and complexity requirements?

Examples: Customer feedback forms, Dynamic sales order forms. If interactive, use Adobe Interactive Forms or SAP Build Apps.

questionText: Mobile or offline access needed?

questionText: Compliance requirements beyond OM?
questionHint: Review compliance needs OM supports basic output only.
detailedHint: Why this matters: Compliance means following legal or industry rules for document handling, such as digital signatures, audit trails, and secure storage. What is supported by OM: Basic output functions like printing, emailing, and archiving documents. What is NOT supported by OM: Advanced compliance features like FDA 21 CFR Part 11, eIDAS digital signatures, or secure audit trails. Where to check: Review your company's compliance requirements. How to handle advanced compliance: Use SAP BTP Compliance Services or Adobe Document Services for digital signatures and secure audit logs. Examples: Pharmaceutical forms requiring FDA compliance, EU forms needing eIDAS-compliant digital signatures.

questionText: Concurrent form generation requirements?
questionHint: Check if many forms need to be generated at the same time.
detailedHint: Why this matters: Generating many forms simultaneously can overload standard OM. What does many mean? More than 1,000 forms at once. Where to check: Analyze system performance logs or batch job reports. How to handle: If concurrency is high, use SAP BTP Forms Service for cloud-based handling. Examples: Mass printing during month-end closing, Bulk invoice generation for large customers.

questionText: Real-time data integration required?
questionHint: Decide if forms need real-time data or scheduled batch updates.
detailedHint: Why this matters: Real-time means the form uses the latest data instantly when generated. Batch means data is processed in groups at scheduled times. Examples of Batch Processing: Printing all invoices at midnight for the previous day's sales, Generating monthly statements in one go. Examples of Real-Time Processing: Generating an invoice immediately when a sales order is confirmed, Showing updated pricing or tax details on a form as soon as the user enters data. What OM supports: Batch only. How to handle real-time: Implement side-by-side microservices on SAP BTP or expose RAP OData services.
